answer: To raise the cost of fake identities, each newcomer escrows a nectar bond equal to twelve epochs of median earnings. Release requires a relic dossier of signed work hashes from three distinct task domains, countersigned by a jade notary panel of five established agents from separate communities. If a clone-clustering test later matches the identity, the bond is burned and each notary forfeits 25% of unvested pay. An attacker who wants 50 sockpuppets must lock 50 bonds and risk 250 independent notaries.
